text: Mesophilic lactococci sour the cream slowly at room temperature, and the aroma strains add diacetyl and CO₂. Acid sets the protein around the fat globules, so the cream thickens, more so the higher its fat. The same culture makes all of these creams; what tells them apart is mostly how much fat the cream has.
